status: source-only sampling sensitivity; no inlet qualification or physical validation
rules: Read only source files and verify archived SHA256 before numerical loading.
Preserve all audited events and measured joint size/velocity/transit-time records; do not trim outliers.
Transit-time weighting is a sensitivity scenario, not a calibrated probe-volume, detection-efficiency or mass-flux correction.
Blocks partition the observed first-to-last arrival interval; acquisition start/end and processor dead time are not inferred.
Resample whole equal-duration blocks with replacement, preserving joint records through additive sufficient statistics.
Report every block-count result; do not choose the narrowest interval or infer independent sample size from weight concentration.

Percentile ranges are conditional stationary-block bootstrap diagnostics, not complete experimental confidence intervals. Serial dependence beyond a block, stopping-rule effects and instrument systematics remain unresolved.
Do not read downstream samples, tune model coefficients or change the 20 percent physical validation criterion.
